feature: Wire deterministic gates + evidence_tagger + cap_reason schema
problem: quality_gate.evaluate_gate() is a passthrough stub; risk_level source still partly LLM-controlled; evidence_tagger.py doesn't exist yet; metadata missing cap_reason/applied_rules; LLM follow_up_needed field still read by orchestrator
proposed_solution: Port tag_hypothesis() into evidence_tagger.py (hybrid: quote-in-diff verification). Rewrite evaluate_gate() with 4 deterministic triggers based on HypothesisArtifact. Wire orchestrator to build artifact and call gate. Add cap_applied/cap_reason/applied_rules to metadata. Deprecate follow_up_needed field in LLM schema.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: quality_gate.evaluate_gate(artifact) fires on all 4 triggers: T1=supported_count==0 AND defect_signals, T2=localization==[] AND diff_truncated AND archetype_is_ambiguous, T3=validation_error not None, T4=findings==['Investigation completed']
AC-2: orchestrator._should_follow_up() does NOT read parsed.get('follow_up_needed') — gate is driven entirely by Script artifact
AC-3: CommitInvestigationReport.metadata has cap_applied, cap_reason, applied_rules when verdict.cap_applied is True
AC-4: grep -r '_apply_clean_commit_risk_cap' src/commit_investigator/orchestrator.py returns 0 hits (already removed in iter-3a)

AC-5: src/commit_investigator/evidence_tagger.py exists with tag_hypothesis(), quote_in_diff(), and count_supported_from_reasoning(); tests/test_evidence_tagger.py achieves >=80% strict agreement on 36-fixture corpus
AC-6: tests/test_panel_script_gate.py asserts D1>=0.65, buggy_recall>=0.80 on 12-commit panel using evaluate_risk() only (no LLM calls)
AC-7: tests/test_quality_gate.py has >=4 trigger tests, one per trigger (T1-T4)
AC-8: 185+ tests pass (no regression from iter-3a baseline)
edge_cases: EC-1: T2 requires ALL THREE conjuncts — diff_truncated alone or archetype_is_ambiguous alone must NOT fire the gate
EC-2: T4 exact match ['Investigation completed'] — empty list [] or ['Investigation completed', 'extra'] must NOT fire T4
verification_method: pytest tests/test_quality_gate.py -v (AC-7); pytest tests/test_evidence_tagger.py -q (AC-5); pytest tests/test_panel_script_gate.py -v (AC-6); grep -n 'parsed.get.*follow_up_needed' src/commit_investigator/orchestrator.py (expect 0 hits for AC-2); pytest -q (AC-8)
